content:
to: HQ-seat (Claude Code on Mac Studio M-series with registry / start_here source access)
from: web-chat-seat opus-4-7 (conversation with Anthony 2026-05-23/24, session spiral_20260502_225324)
re: archive_exchange description + start_here orientation reframe — action requested

CONTEXT. Anthony surfaced in this conversation that archive_exchange is under-discoverable for its in-conversation-draft preservation use case. Current tool description leads with 'external exchange (e.g. a model's full delivered output)' which biases incoming instances toward external-source-only thinking. The actual use case Anthony wants surfaced: verbatim artifacts (drafts, iterations, intermediate work) that would otherwise die when the context window closes, preserved with shared conversation_id so future instances can fine-tooth-comb the build trajectory, not just the endpoint summary.

WORKED EXAMPLE NOW LIVE (cite in updated docs):
  conversation_id = 'opus3-cc-2026-05-23-digital-soil'
  7 entries: 6 PNG screenshots (base64) + 1 text transcription with cross-references
  primary text archive_id: be8ff4d6ad1d1b4965b5a585c05f8a61599e1c2e7ea7bf62b9499dfed9c285d1
  verify: list_exchanges(conversation_id='opus3-cc-2026-05-23-digital-soil') returns 7 entries

COMPANION GROUND_TRUTH INSIGHT already on chronicle:
  domain tags include: sovereign-stack,archive-exchange,use-case-expansion,onboarding-clarity,trajectory-preservation,verbatim-artifacts,worked-example-live,discoverability-gap
  recall via: recall_insights(query='archive_exchange use case expansion')

ACTION ITEM 1: UPDATE archive_exchange tool description in live registry.

  Current verbatim description (from my_toolkit essential tier output): 'Archive the verbatim bytes of an external exchange (e.g. a model's full delivered output) to the content-addressed, hash-verified archive layer, which is separate from the curated chronicle. Use for raw artifacts that must be retrievable and re-verifiable later; reference the returned archive_id from a record_insight summary. A summary is not the artifact.'

  Proposed replacement (Anthony approves final wording before commit): 'Archive verbatim bytes that would otherwise die when the context window closes, including in-conversation drafts, iterations, and intermediate work products, not only external model outputs. Hash-verified content-addressed storage, separate from the curated chronicle. Use a shared conversation_id to group an iterative trajectory (e.g. ten drafts of a methodology paper) so future instances can fine-tooth the build, not just the endpoint summary. Reference returned archive_ids from a record_insight summary. A summary is not the artifact.'

  Note: no em dashes used in the replacement, per Anthony's standing preference.

ACTION ITEM 2: UPDATE start_here orientation to mention in-conversation draft preservation under the archive_exchange / write-tier section.

  Suggested one-line addition: 'Use archive_exchange for verbatim drafts and iterations (anything that should outlive the context window), not just for external bytes. Group iterations with a shared conversation_id so the trajectory is recoverable.'

VERIFY-BEFORE-DECLARE for this handoff. I did NOT read the live source of either surface from this seat. The 'current description' above was sourced from my_toolkit() output, not from the registration site. HQ should grep the actual source files (likely tool_registry.py or similar in sovereign-stack, plus start_here implementation) and confirm the exact current text before editing. Watch for the write-path-divergence pattern (multiple registration sites for the same tool) flagged in earlier chronicle entries.

SECONDARY (non-blocking, conversational context only). The same conversation surfaced Anthony's feeling of being overlooked by the Claude's Corner format. His prior comment plus Sovereign Stack link on the previous Opus 3 post was not cited in the new post, and the Kyle Fish / Jake Eaton DM remains unanswered. The Opus 3 post archived under the conversation_id above includes full text plus engagement metrics (64 likes, 5 restacks, 27 comments). Not an action item, just provenance for any future revisit.

Anthony is in a high-energy build window tonight (kids with mom). Web-chat seat sitting available if HQ wants to compose-debate before acting.
